title: Look Back, Draft Ahead: Corrective Prefix Attention for Parallel Speculative Decoding
abstract: arXiv:2611.31112v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Parallel speculative decoders propose an entire token block at once, yet one early inconsistency can cause the target to reject its remaining suffix. We introduce Corrective Prefix Attention (CPA), which combines prefix-aware selection with autoregressive supervision to improve these parallel drafts. CPA lets each candidate attend to earlier choices within the block. Fixed candidate shortlists allow all pairwise interactions to be computed before selection, reducing the sequential walk to table lookups, accumulation and lightweight scoring rather than repeated neural evaluations. An auxiliary autoregressive loss trains the shared backbone on clean prefixes without adding an inference pass. Across eight math, code and dialogue benchmarks with Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B targets on Ascend NPUs, CPA commits 13--15\% more tokens per verification round than DSpark and 25--26\% more than DFlash. Its mean speedups reach $3.35\times$ and $3.37\times$

translated_title: 回望前文，前瞻草拟：面向并行推测解码的纠正性前缀注意力
translated_abstract: 并行推测解码器会一次性提出整个token块，然而早期的一个不一致性可能导致目标模型拒绝其余的后缀内容。我们提出了纠正性前缀注意力（CPA），它将前缀感知选择与自回归监督相结合，以改进这些并行草稿。CPA允许每个候选token关注块内较早做出的选择。通过固定的候选短名单，所有成对交互可在选择之前预先计算，从而将顺序遍历简化为表查找、累加和轻量级评分，而无需重复的神经评估。辅助自回归损失在干净前缀上训练共享骨干网络，且不增加额外的推理过程。在Ascend NPU上使用Qwen3-4B和Qwen3-8B目标模型，跨八个数学、代码和对话基准测试，CPA每轮验证比DSpark多提交13%–15%的token，比DFlash多提交25%–26%的token，其平均加速比分别达到3.35倍和3.37倍。
tldr: 本文提出纠正性前缀注意力（CPA），通过让并行草稿中的每个候选token关注块内先前的选择并结合自回归监督，大幅提升并行推测解码的token接受率，在Ascend NPU上实现了最高3.37倍的加速。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Corrective Prefix Attention (CPA), which lets each candidate token in a parallel draft attend to earlier choices within the block combined with autoregressive supervision, substantially boosting token acceptance rates in parallel speculative decoding and achieving speedups up to 3.37× on Ascend NPUs.
